request.style: English, warm male tenor solo with soft choir, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, gentle strings, hopeful and steady, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Do not let wicked hearts grow
Far from the living God
See to it you do not stray
On this holy road

[Chorus]
Encourage one another every day
As long as it is called today
So none of you are hardened
By the deceit of sin

[Verse]
We share in Christ if we hold fast
Our confidence to the end
Hear the voice and do not rebel
Against the Father

[Chorus]
Encourage one another every day
As long as it is called today
So none of you are hardened
By the deceit of sin

[Bridge]
Their hearts went astray for forty years
In anger God swore
But we can find rest if we believe
And keep the covenant

[Chorus]
Encourage one another every day
As long as it is called today
So none of you are hardened
By the deceit of sin

[Outro]
Hold your confidence firm to the end
Encourage one another daily
